+def _pathbank_archive_terms(
+    path: Path, *, url: str, sha256: str, archive: Any,
+) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]]:
+    """Verify actual ZIP and member bytes before native membership selection."""
+    validate_pathbank_archive(url, sha256, archive)
+    raw = path.read_bytes()
+    if len(raw) != archive["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != sha256:
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP original bytes disagree with archive provenance")
+    try:
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as source:
+            members = [info for info in source.infolist() if info.filename == archive["member"]]
+            if (len(members) != 1 or members[0].is_dir()
+                    or members[0].file_size != archive["member_bytes"]):
+                raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP requires one exact member with bound byte count")
+            member = source.read(members[0])
+    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError, NotImplementedError) as error:
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP member could not be verified") from error
+    if (len(member) != archive["member_bytes"]
+            or hashlib.sha256(member).hexdigest() != archive["member_sha256"]):
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP member bytes disagree with member provenance")
+    root = ElementTree.fromstring(member)
+    if (root.tag != "{http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#}RDF"
+            or any(not node.tag.startswith("{http://www.biopax.org/release/biopax-level3.owl#}")
+                   and node.tag != "{http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#}Ontology" for node in root)):
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP member requires native RDF/BioPAX object types")
+    return list(pathbank_terms(root, url=url, archive_root=archive["root"]))

+def archive_fixture(tmp_path, root=None):
+    if root is None:
+        root = native_source()
+        add_stub(root)
+    body = ET.tostring(root)
+    path = tmp_path / "primary.zip"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
+        archive.writestr("PW9999999.owl", body)
+    return path, {
+        "key": "archive", "kind": PATHBANK_ARCHIVE_KIND, "path": path.name,
+        "url": PATHBANK_ARCHIVE_URL, "version": "fixture", "license": "fixture",
+        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+        "archive": {"bytes": path.stat().st_size, "member": "PW9999999.owl",
+                    "member_bytes": len(body), "member_sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
+                    "root": "SMP9999999"},
+    }
+

+def parse_archive(path, entry):
+    return list(source_terms(entry["kind"], path, url=entry["url"], version=entry["version"],
+                             archive=entry.get("archive"), sha256=entry["sha256"]))
+

+def archive_snapshot(tmp_path):
+    path, entry = archive_fixture(tmp_path)
+    records = tmp_path / "records"
+    records.mkdir()
+    (records / "record.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump({
+        "id": PATHWAY, "label": "Curated title never used as authority", "participants": [
+            {"id": PATHWAY + "/ProteinComplex/8", "label": "Curated complex"}],
+        "reactions": [{"id": "PathBank:SMP9999998", "label": "Curated child"}],
+    }))
+    manifest = tmp_path / "manifest.json"
+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps([entry]))
+    return build_snapshot(manifest, records, tmp_path), entry, path, manifest, records
+

+def test_archive_bytes_root_and_attached_names_remain_independent_authority(tmp_path):
+    snapshot, entry, path, _, _ = archive_snapshot(tmp_path)
+    terms = parse_archive(path, entry)
+    assert terms == list(pathbank_terms(ET.fromstring(zipfile.ZipFile(path).read(
+        entry["archive"]["member"])), url=DOWNLOAD))
+    metadata = snapshot["sources"]["archive"]
+    assert metadata["sha256"] == entry["sha256"]
+    assert metadata["archive"] == entry["archive"]
+    assert metadata["url"] == PATHBANK_ARCHIVE_URL
+    assert metadata["pathway_accessions"] == ["SMP9999999", "SMP9999998"]
+    assert snapshot["terms"]["PathBank:SMP9999998"]["label"] == "Adjacent native pathway"
+    assert snapshot["terms"][PATHWAY + "/ProteinComplex/8"]["label_kind"] == "source_context"

+    path, entry = archive_fixture(tmp_path)

+        entry["sha256"] = "0" * 64
+    elif problem in {"archive-bytes", "member-bytes"}:
+        archive["bytes" if problem == "archive-bytes" else "member_bytes"] += 1
+    elif problem == "member-hash":
+        archive["member_sha256"] = "0" * 64
+    elif problem == "member-missing":
+        archive["member"] = "PW0000000.owl"
+    elif problem in {"root-missing", "root-stub"}:
+        archive["root"] = "SMP0000000" if problem == "root-missing" else "SMP9999998"
+    elif problem.endswith("url") or problem.startswith("url-"):

+    elif problem == "member-path":
+        archive["member"] = "../PW9999999.owl"
+    elif problem in {"bool-bytes", "string-bytes"}:
+        archive["bytes"] = True if problem == "bool-bytes" else str(archive["bytes"])

+
+### Exact PathBank archive selection
+
+`pathbank-biopax-zip` reads the independently acquired official primary ZIP at
+`https://pathbank.org/downloads/pathbank_primary_biopax.zip`. Its manifest `path`
+points to the original ZIP, and `sha256` hashes that whole ZIP. A required closed
+`archive` object contains `bytes` (positive integer archive byte count), `member`
+(an exact `PW` plus digits and `.owl` filename), `member_bytes` (positive integer),
+`member_sha256` (the exact unmodified member digest), and `root` (the selected
+native `SMP` accession). Neither a filename nor a curated label supplies the
+root identity. The ZIP and selected member hashes and byte counts are verified
+before XML parsing. Missing or duplicate selected member names fail.
+
+This separate source kind applies the existing exact primary-pathway and
+attached-interface checks to that verified member. The selected root must match
+its native SMPDB assertion; unrelated or expanded extra pathways still fail.
+The builder preserves the closed archive object, typed `kind`, real archive URL
+and whole-archive digest in source metadata. It also emits `pathway_accessions`
+from the verified primary and attached objects, with the selected root first.
+The snapshot consumer validates those typed fields and restricts associated
+terms to those pathway accessions or the selected root's local graph IDs.
+Canonical pathway titles and contextual local labels retain their prior rules.
+Typed fields cannot be attached to an untyped or different source kind.
+
+A frozen archive member is never attributed to a live per-pathway URL. This
+kind does not accept `sha256_scope` as a substitute for typed byte bindings.
+Legacy `pathbank-biopax` extracted single-pathway members retain their earlier
+`sha256_scope` behavior, and actual per-pathway downloads keep their existing
+selection contract. Existing authority entries need no format migration.
+
+### Native Compound class references
+
+An unnamed `metacyc-reaction-xml` small-molecule reaction may have the optional
+literal `class="true"` on a direct Compound side reference. The exact native
+resource, organism and frame guards still apply; other class values, extra
+attributes, class markers on side wrappers and duplicate side frames fail.
+The class marker is retained in same-frame conflict comparisons, so a class
+reference cannot silently overwrite an unmarked assertion. This does not alter
+the unnamed frame-token authority label or establish chemical/anomer identity.

+"""Closed provenance contract for independently acquired PathBank ZIP members."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from typing import Any
+
+PATHBANK_ARCHIVE_KIND = "pathbank-biopax-zip"
+PATHBANK_ARCHIVE_URL = "https://pathbank.org/downloads/pathbank_primary_biopax.zip"
+
+
+def validate_pathbank_archive(url: str, sha256: str, archive: Any) -> None:
+    """Check typed bindings; the builder additionally verifies the original bytes."""
+    if url != PATHBANK_ARCHIVE_URL:
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP requires the exact official archive URL")
+    if not isinstance(sha256, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", sha256):
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP requires an exact archive SHA-256")
+    if not isinstance(archive, dict) or archive.keys() != {
+        "bytes", "member", "member_bytes", "member_sha256", "root",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP requires a closed archive provenance object")
+    if any(type(archive[key]) is not int or archive[key] <= 0
+           for key in ("bytes", "member_bytes")):
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP archive/member byte counts must be positive integers")
+    patterns = {
+        "member": r"PW[0-9]+\.owl",
+        "member_sha256": r"[0-9a-f]{64}",
+        "root": r"SMP[0-9]+",
+    }
+    if any(not isinstance(archive[key], str) or not re.fullmatch(pattern, archive[key])
+           for key, pattern in patterns.items()):
+        raise ValueError("PathBank ZIP requires exact native member, hash and root identities")
